mn136:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
mn136:2.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā samiddhi araññakuṭikāyaṃ viharati.
mn136:2.2: atha kho potaliputto paribbājako jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno yenāyasmā samiddhi tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā samiddhinā saddhiṃ sammodi
mn136:2.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho potaliputto paribbājako āyasmantaṃ samiddhiṃ etadavoca
mn136:2.4: sammukhā metaṃ āvuso samiddhi samaṇassa gotamassa sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
mn136:2.5: moghaṃ kāyakammaṃ moghaṃ vacīkammaṃ manokammameva saccanti
mn136:2.6: atthi ca sā samāpatti yaṃ samāpattiṃ samāpanno na kiñci vediyatīti.
mn136:2.7: mā evaṃ āvuso potaliputta avaca mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkha na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya
mn136:2.8: moghaṃ kāyakammaṃ moghaṃ vacīkammaṃ manokammameva saccanti
mn136:2.9: atthi ca kho sā āvuso samāpatti yaṃ samāpattiṃ samāpanno na kiñci vediyatīti
mn136:2.12: etthadāni mayaṃ there bhikkhū kiṃ vakkhāma yatra hi nāma evaṃ navo bhikkhu satthāraṃ parirakkhitabbaṃ maññissati
mn136:2.13: sañcetanikaṃ āvuso samiddhi kammaṃ katvā kāyena vācāya manasā kiṃ so vediyatīti.
mn136:2.14: sañcetanikaṃ āvuso potaliputta kammaṃ katvā kāyena vācāya manasā dukkhaṃ so vediyatīti.

mn136:3.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn136:3.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā samiddhi yāvatako ahosi potaliputtena paribbājakena saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo taṃ sabbaṃ āyasmato ānandattherassa ārocesi.
mn136:3.4: evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando āyasmantaṃ samiddhiṃ etadavoca
mn136:3.5: atthi kho idaṃ āvuso samiddhi kathāpābhataṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya
mn136:3.6: āyāmāvuso samiddhi yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkameyyāma upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ bhagavato āroceyyāma
mn136:3.7: yathā no bhagavā byākarissati tathā naṃ dhāreyyāmāti.
mn136:3.8: evamāvusoti kho āyasmā samiddhi āyasmato ānandassa paccassosi.
mn136:4.1: atha kho āyasmā ca samiddhi āyasmā ca ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
mn136:4.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando yāvatako ahosi āyasmato samiddhissa potaliputtena paribbājakena saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesi.
mn136:5.1: evaṃ vutte bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
mn136:5.2: dassanampi kho ahaṃ ānanda potaliputtassa paribbājakassa nābhijānāmi kuto panevarūpaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ
mn136:5.3: imināva ānanda samiddhinā moghapurisena potaliputtassa paribbājakassa vibhajabyākaraṇīyo pañho ekaṃsena byākatoti.
mn136:6.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā udāyi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn136:6.2: sace pana bhante āyasmatā samiddhinā idaṃ sandhāya bhāsitaṃ
mn136:6.4: evaṃ vutte bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi
mn136:6.5: passa kho tvaṃ ānanda imassa udāyissa moghapurisassa ummaggaṃ
mn136:6.7: idānevāyaṃ udāyi moghapuriso ummujjamāno ayoniso ummujjissati
mn136:6.8: ādiṃyeva ānanda potaliputtena paribbājakena tisso vedanā pucchitā
mn136:6.9: sacāyaṃ ānanda samiddhi moghapuriso potaliputtassa paribbājakassa evaṃ puṭṭho evaṃ byākareyya
